content:
# 理解期权订单流及其交易策略

期权订单流的本质是什么？如何据此交易？

简言之，期权订单流是特定时间段内各类期权合约的买卖数量，可用于预测个股及指数的走势。

这正是成功交易期权必须理解订单流运作机制的核心原因。

![](/blog/5.jpg)

初看期权订单流图表时，可能只呈现为难以解读的箭头符号组合。

但通过实践，可掌握解读技巧，利用图表信息在经纪账户中实现盈利交易。

本文阐释期权订单流的本质，以及交易者如何借此建立优势。

## 核心概念

股票期权作为衍生品，其价值锚定于标的资产。

标的资产即股票。这使期权订单流与股票订单流具有相似性。理解订单流对成功交易者至关重要，因期权流揭示异常大额交易，可洞悉其他交易者与机构的动向。

掌握期权订单流对价格的影响机制，可调整特定头寸的风险敞口，甚至在高影响事件前提前布局。

## 期权流基础原理

交易者需明确三种订单成交方式： 
即时成交 
未来特定时间/日期成交 
未成交 

第二类成交方式即构成期权流。当零售交易者无法确认订单是否通过时，本质在进行观望式交易。

期权流允许市场参与者在未无限期等待成交的情况下实施方向性策略。因期权交易量远低于股票，常出现订单因需求不足无法即时成交的情况。

## 期权流类型

主要存在两类订单流：
卖方流：做市商收到大量客户订单，被迫调整期权报价 
买方流：机构投资者大额订单引发做市商重新定价 

## 订单流分析价值

无论是否接触过订单流概念，深入理解其对盈利逻辑的揭示都至关重要。

## 数学视角的巧合交易

以SPY期权分析为例，对到期前不足1小时的期权进行测算。

对比该时刻未平仓合约量与分钟级交易量，计算每百万张合约中的巧合频次（1张SPY合约对应百万股）。

结果显示：平均每百万张合约存在超20,000次巧合交易。

巧合交易指：买入临到期期权后迅速卖出，或卖出临到期期权后立即回补。

此类情形意味着可合理预判股票短期波动方向。

为验证数学可能性，仅用百万张交易数据测算：每1亿张合约仅出现1次巧合。

## 数据获取机制：非公开与公开组合

当前通过盈透证券等平台可获取实时期权分析数据，但经纪商数据如同雅虎股价信息——可用但效果有限。

核心价值在于同时获取非公开与公开数据组合。

盈透证券等平台使该组合获取便捷且低成本。在"股票科技"框架下，OA本质是交易行为的映射。

## 价格发现的副产品

运作机制：经纪商在期权公开活动结束后，汇总客户建仓/平仓（及行权价调整）订单。

该机制确保非公开活动不被暴露。

## OPR成交交易实例

所有参与者均受影响。

即使自认精通期权交易，也必须认知今日SPY期权（$SPY）的动向。

无论过程是否令人困惑。

无论是否获得解释。

当基于期权订单成交（OPR）交易时，必须理解事件对未来策略的影响。

该认知在当前尤为重要——下文解析后将不言自明。

## OPR机制解析

期权订单成交（OPR） 指标的资产达到期权交易指定价格时触发的执行机制。

当投资者设定期权限定价后，标的股票触及该价格即触发OPR。

## OPR用户群体

挂单买入股票时，需决策未成交是否卖出。

若不欲持有，为何挂单？

OPR成交的核心价值在于洞悉其来源。

毕竟若无用户群体，"专业"即无意义。

OPR是华尔街投行使用的计算机系统。

投资者通过经纪商下单时，指令经多层系统传输。

信息验证过程中同步发送至多家投行，供其判断是否跟单。

若挂单100股IBM限定价$100，前方可能已有1000股买单排队。

## OprFlow最佳时机：择机而动

每周存在订单流异常活跃时段。

这创造双重机遇： 
借OprFlow数据择机建仓 
观察平仓头寸决定是否跟进 

交易期权时，关注OprFlow数据并规避高活跃时段。

在活跃度较低的时段，往往更易捕获稳定价格的优质机会。周边活动减少也降低价格异动概率。

该策略在低成交量日或临近到期日尤具效力——此时期权流数据同步衰减。

## 结论

多数亏损源于对订单流的误读。掌握要诀可建立交易优势：

解读订单流平均提升10%以上收益。

关键在于识别有效信号。作为职业交易者，深谙此道。

>温馨提示：AI 很聪明，但并非万能。在你将投资组合交给 AI 管理之前，请记住：再强大的系统也不是万无一失。市场充满不确定性，即便是最先进的 AI，也难以准确预测每一次突如其来的波动。

>人工智能应作为辅助决策的工具，而非预测未来的“水晶球”。我们诚邀您阅读我们的研究论文：《构建用于金融指导与经济预测的聊天机器人：基于 GPT 大语言模型与搜索引擎数据的探索》

content:
# Understanding What Option Order Flows Are and How To Trade Options?

What exactly are option order flows? And how do you trade them?

In short, option order flows are the number of shares in various options that are bought or sold over a particular period of time, and they can be used to predict the movements of individual stocks and indexes.

That’s why it’s important to understand how option order flows work if you want to trade options successfully.

![](/blog/5.jpg)

When you first look at an option order flow chart, it may appear to be nothing more than an indecipherable series of up and down arrows with letters on them.

With some practice, however, you can learn to interpret these charts and use the information they provide to make profitable trades in your brokerage account.

This article will explain what option order flows are and how you can use them to your advantage as an options trader.

## Introduction

Stock options are derivatives, which means they derive their value from an underlying asset.

That underlying asset is a stock. This makes option order flows similar to stock order flows. Understanding order flows has always been important for successful traders, as options flow uncovers large and unusual option trades to monitor what other traders and institutions are doing.

As such, knowing how option order flows influence option prices allows you to adjust your risk profile on certain positions and even get in before high-impact news hits.

## The Basics of Option Flow

It’s important for traders to understand that there are three different ways that an option order can fill:

1. Immediately

2. at some future time/date

3. not at all.

The second type of execution—to be filled at some future time/date—is referred to as an option flow. When a retail options trader is executing an option trade and has no idea if his/her order will go through, he/she is essentially entering a wait-and-see option trade.

Option flows allow market participants to take action on their directional bets without having to wait indefinitely for their trades to fill. Because options trade at such low volumes relative to stocks, sometimes an investor’s options simply don’t get enough demand from other investors in order to complete a trade immediately when it hits the tape.

## Types of Option Flow

There are two main types of option order flows: sell-side and buy-side.

Sell-side flow is when a market maker or broker receives a large number of orders from their clients, which causes them to increase or decrease their quotes on options.

Buy-side flow, on the other hand, is when one or more institutional investors (such as hedge funds) place large orders in a particular stock, causing market makers to change their option prices.

## Why Do We Analyze Option Order Flows?

If you trade options, you’ve probably heard of order flow—or maybe not.

Regardless, if you want to develop a better understanding of why option trading is so profitable (and profitable, in general), it’s important that you know what option order flows are and how they can help guide your strategy.

## How Many Coincidences Until Mathematically Impossible?

Using my analysis for SPY options as an example, I ran a calculation on options with less than one hour before expiration.

I compared open interest at that time against total options volume in that minute—as well as previous minutes—and calculated how many coincidences existed per 1 million options traded (since there are about 1 million shares of SPY in one contract).

I found that, on average, there were just over 20,000 coincidences out of a million contracts.

A coincidence is when an investor buys an expiring option then sells it shortly after; conversely, they could also sell an expiring option then buy it shortly after.

In either case, coincidences represent a situation where you’re able to predict with a reasonable degree of certainty that a stock will move by a set amount in a short time frame.

To determine whether it’s mathematically possible for coincidences to exist, I ran another calculation using just 1 million options traded—and found that there was only 1 coincidence out of 100 million options traded!

## Getting the Data: 80% covert, 20% public.

Up until a few years ago, there were no good sources for options order flow information. Now we have options analytics available from big brokers (e.g., Interactive Brokers) that give you access to real-time trading data.

I know many traders who only use OA as their primary source of trade ideas. To be fair, using broker-supplied data is similar to getting stock price information from Yahoo or Google (e.g., you can do it but your results won’t be that great).

The real utility in option order flow information comes when you get access to both public-private and data.

This combo has become very easy and inexpensive with brokers like Interactive Brokers (IBKR) so check them out if you haven’t already! At Stonk Tech its core, OA is basically just information about what traders are doing.

## It’s a byproduct of price discovery.

Here’s how it works: Brokers aggregate all of their client's option orders as they enter or exit positions (and/or change their desired strike prices).

This isn’t done until all public activity in an option is complete, so that private activity isn’t exposed.

## Trading on OPR Fills - An Example

No One Walks Away from this. No one.

Even if you think you know how to trade options, it’s important that you know what happened today with SPY options (the $SPY).

Even if it was confusing.

Even if no one is going to explain it to you.

It happened and we need to understand what it means moving forward when trading on option order fills (OPR) as opposed to just watching them move as they occur live on a screen as they happen.

And it’s incredibly important to know now, because, well – you will see why in about a second once I’ve explained OPR...

The more you trade-in options, or if you’re a novice trader but want to learn, I will give you some solid advice.

### Let’s get started with option order fills...

An option order fill (OPR) is an execution that occurs when a specific price is reached on a stock or index in relation to an options trade.

The way it works is that when you place an options trade, you can specify a limit price.

Which then triggers an OPR once that limit price is reached by way of your stock being at that level or higher.

## Who Uses OPR Fills?

When you place an order to buy a stock, you must decide whether you will sell that stock if your order isn’t filled.

If you don’t want it, why are you placing an order?

Enter OPR fills – what they are, who uses them, and how they can be used in your favor. The most important detail about OPR fills is understanding where they come from.

After all, there’s no point in being a professional if no one uses your services.

To get an idea of who uses OPR fills, you must first understand that OPR is a computer system used by investment banks around Wall Street.

When an investor places an order on his or her trading platform (typically through their broker), it is sent through several computers before it reaches its destination.

This information must then be validated, but it also goes out to various investment banks so they can determine if they want that same trade.

If you place a limit order for 100 shares of IBM at $100 per share, chances are there’s a potential buyer in line ahead of you with a limit order for 1,000 shares.

## Best Times to Use OprFlow: Save the Best for Last.

In any given week, some days are going to see much higher option order flow than others.

This creates a two-fold opportunity.

You can use OprFlow data to determine when to put in a new trade order.

Or you can see which option positions are getting closed out and decide if you want to jump in on that action by opening up your own trades accordingly.

If you’re looking for a good time to buy or sell options, pay attention to OprFlow data and avoid times when there is higher than average activity.

You’ll likely have much better luck at these calmer times of lower activity.

It will be easier for you to find solid opportunities at a relatively stable price. In addition, there is less chance of seeing a big change in an option’s price because there is less activity surrounding it.

This strategy works especially well on low-volume days or when options are moving towards their expiration date since OprFlow data tends to diminish during these times as well.

## Conclusion

A lot of traders lose money when trading options because they don’t understand option order flows. However, there are several tips that you can use to give yourself an edge when trading these products.

By learning how to read option order flows, you can increase your profits by 10% or more on average.

You just need to know what clues to look for. As a professional day trader, I’ve learned how to read option order flows.

# What Are Dark Pool Prints And How Does This Info Help With Trading?

A dark pool print is an important piece of information when it comes to certain types of securities trading.

These securities are only available in the over-the-counter market, which means that these trades aren’t on exchanges like the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE) or Nasdaq.

There are also different kinds of securities trading that can happen in this market, and you can learn about them by reading our beginner’s guide to dark pool trading.

When you trade these kinds of securities, you might hear people talking about dark pool prints and wondering what they mean.

Dark pool prints have been around for over 30 years. They allow traders to track their performance and make more money trading stocks than they would without it.

However, the average investor doesn’t even know what dark pool trading is.

Not to mention, how to start using this powerful tool in their own day-to-day trading activities.

If you want to learn more about dark pool prints and how they can help with your stock trading, keep reading!

## Dark Pools

We tell you to question everything. So let's define dark pools.

It's where stocks and other assets trade when no one is looking.

NOT on exchanges but among themselves through computerized matching systems operated by banks, hedge funds, or other 
financial institutions. This can cause a delay in pricing information that could cost you, especially if you try to buy or sell a stock at exactly that time.

While some dark pools enable trades from many different sources, others allow buyers and sellers only from certain pre-approved groups of investors. 

You'd have to read T+3 on a mutual fund trade as an example of a small window for pricing information.These small windows can end up costing you money if you try to buy or sell at just that time.

Many folks say there's simply no way to know how much market prices change during these intervals until they're over.

There is no set definition for dark pools, but many experts agree that when investors lack direct information about available prices, it becomes impossible to determine how prices change during periods of darkness.

The ability to monitor price changes is considered by many professionals to be one of the fundamental skills necessary for market analysis.

In other words, if you don't know how far a security's price moves while it's not visible to you, there's no way you can use that information in your decision-making process.

It's simply unknown information.

![](/blog/4.jpg)

## Dark Pools and Volume

For Stonk Tech, dark pools represent a volume of trading that’s often not made available to the public.

In fact, it can be difficult to detect and follow because unlike securities exchanges like NYSE or NASDAQ, dark pools don’t have a central marketplace.

They’re usually private agreements between brokers and dealers that execute trades in off-exchange markets.

To decipher trade volumes, analysts look at a company’s message board. There, they study dark pool print volumes to determine which of those pools represent legitimate trading.

## Dark Pool Prints

Once analysts have identified that data, they can factor it into their strategy.

For example, a message board will have dark pool volumes from a company’s newly issued shares: insiders that are trading on new company news.

If analysts see large-volume prints in one particular pool they’ll analyze its participants to determine if it’s worth getting involved with or moving forward with our position.

Some companies’ message boards will also publish their volume breakdowns, which can be especially helpful for traders.It allows them to compare different liquidity sources for a company so they can decide which pool or exchange is right for a particular stock.

For example, consider that most big bank stocks trade in dark pools. 

So if a financial institution like JPMorgan announced quarterly earnings, that typically means there will be some movement on their securities. If we see trades in their underlying shares hitting an unusual volume level in one particularly dark pool, we’ll buy into those messages by doing our own research before investing.

The message board will usually break down dark pool volumes with the stock exchange.

Some companies that trade on a particular public exchange may also trade in multiple private pools. That’s why we encourage our analysts to compare their message boards with exchanges like NYSE, NASDAQ, TSX, etc.

## Dark Pools and Price Impact

It’s always a good idea to know where your trading partners are.

With over 98% of all volume now conducted in dark pools, knowing if you’re trading against a dark pool or not is vital.

That said, there aren’t any widely accepted rules for how to price impact should be calculated for orders placed inside dark pools and those placed outside of them.

A small change in an order price can cause a large swing in their price impact.

But when that swing occurs on either side of a large order (and trades in two separate markets), it makes sense to assume that much of that movement is not market-induced but caused by your own initial order.

This kind of Intel is worth remembering, which will help you gauge where you might be having an impact on your trading partners’ prices, allowing you to react accordingly.

Not to mention, how you profit from it.

In recent years dark pools have boomed in popularity: They’re one of many ways that large firms execute trades without impacting share prices.

Like with anything worth its salt, there are pros and cons associated with these types of orders as well.

But what exactly do they consist of anyway?

Orders placed in dark pools aren’t broadcast to publicly traded exchanges until after an order has been executed, which means prices won’t be impacted by its presence on a market.

However, not all orders placed within dark pools remain there.

We're here to bring the dark pool trading to light.

## How Can Dark Pools Help Me Trade Better?

Learning dark pools message board style to help you trade efficiently. If you’re a novice trader, dark pools can offer a better way to learn how to trade.

Learning in real-time can be a dangerous thing when it comes to trading. The fastest traders often dominate, leaving little space for those who have yet to master their craft.

On a dark pool message board, though, there is no time limit. That's because nothing can stop what is coming. As you continue to invest in learning how to trade efficiently, you’ll notice that nothing ever disappears.

The key is to keep your eye on the market as it grows around you. Don't be afraid of those who've already learned from mistakes that are made in front of your eyes. Learning how to trade takes time, but trading is a path best traveled one step at a time.

Everyone learns differently.

You are learning. How many coincidences until mathematically impossible?

Try new strategies out to see what works for you, but never stop reading.

Most importantly, though, keep an eye on how other traders interact on dark pool message boards and observe their successes (and failures).

## Question Everything You Know About Dark Pool Trades

There’s not much information out there about them, so you probably have a lot of questions. We’re here to answer your most important ones! 

If you have experience trading dark pool trades, do you agree or disagree with our conclusions? If you don’t have first-hand experience trading dark pool trades, what questions would you like to ask someone who does?

By thinking logically and making this hidden agenda public, Stonk Tech has created an insightful look into a dark pool trade for traders.

We’ve broken down how we uncovered these secrets in easy-to-understand language so you can make your own investment decisions.

This is where you come in! Remember, let’s trade better, together!

content:
# 什么是暗池成交记录？这些信息如何助力交易？

暗池成交记录是特定类型证券交易中的关键信息。

这些证券仅在柜台交易市场（OTC）提供，意味着交易不会在纽约证券交易所（NYSE）或纳斯达克（Nasdaq）等公开交易所进行。

该市场还存在多种证券交易类型，您可通过阅读我们的[暗池交易初学者指南]了解详情。

当您交易此类证券时，可能会听到人们谈论暗池成交记录（Dark Pool Prints），并好奇其含义。

暗池成交记录已有30多年历史。它们让交易者能追踪自身表现，并在股票交易中获得比未使用时更高的收益。

然而，普通投资者甚至不了解何为暗池交易。

更遑论如何将这一强大工具应用于日常交易活动。

若您想深入了解暗池成交记录及其对股票交易的助益，请继续阅读！

## 暗池（Dark Pools）

我们倡导质疑精神。因此先定义暗池。

这是股票等资产在无人关注时交易的场所。

交易**并非**在交易所进行，而是通过银行、对冲基金或其他金融机构运营的计算机化撮合系统在参与者间完成。这可能导致定价信息延迟，若您恰在此时尝试买卖股票，可能蒙受损失。

部分暗池允许多种来源的交易，而另一些仅限特定预批准投资者群体的买卖双方参与。

例如，共同基金交易的T+3结算周期就是一个定价信息短暂窗口期。若您恰在此窗口期买卖，可能付出额外成本。

许多人认为，在暗池交易时段结束前，根本无法知晓市场价格变动幅度。

暗池尚无统一定义，但专家共识是：当投资者无法直接获取可用价格信息时，将难以判断黑暗期间的价格变化。

监测价格变动能力被众多专业人士视为市场分析的基本功。

换言之，若您不知晓证券在不可见期间的价格波动范围，便无法将此信息纳入决策过程。

这本质上是未知信息。

![](/blog/4.jpg)

## 暗池与交易量

对"股票科技"（Stonk Tech）而言，暗池代表着常不向公众公开的交易量。

事实上，由于其不像纽交所或纳斯达克等证券交易所有集中市场，暗池交易量难以检测和追踪。

它们通常是经纪商与交易商之间的私人协议，在场外市场执行交易。

为解析交易量，分析师会研究公司数据看板（message board），通过分析暗池成交记录量来判断哪些属于真实交易。

## 暗池成交记录

分析师识别有效数据后，即可将其纳入交易策略。

例如，公司数据看板会显示新发行股票的暗池交易量：即内部人士根据公司新消息进行的交易。

若分析师发现某暗池出现大额成交记录，将分析其参与者以决定是否值得介入或调整头寸。

部分公司数据看板还会公布交易量细分，这对交易者尤为有用。它使交易者能比较同一股票的不同流动性来源，从而判断哪个暗池或交易所最适合特定股票。

例如，多数大型银行股在暗池交易。

因此当摩根大通等金融机构公布季度财报时，通常意味着其证券将出现波动。若我们发现其标的股票在某个暗池出现异常交易量，会先自行研究再跟进入场。

数据看板通常会将暗池交易量与股票交易所数据对照呈现。

某些在特定公开交易所交易的公司，也可能同时在多个私有暗池交易。因此我们鼓励分析师将数据看板与纽交所、纳斯达克、多伦多证交所等交易所数据交叉比对。

## 暗池与价格影响

洞悉交易对手位置始终有益。

如今98%以上的交易量发生在暗池，判断自己是否在与暗池交易至关重要。

话虽如此，对于暗池内外订单的价格影响计算，目前尚无广泛接受的规则。

订单价格的微小变动可能引发价格影响的剧烈波动。

但当波动发生在大额订单两侧（且在两个独立市场交易）时，有理由推测大部分波动并非市场诱导，而是由您的初始订单引发。

此类情报值得铭记，它可帮助您评估自身对交易对手价格的影响程度，从而及时应对。

更不用说如何从中获利。

近年来暗池大受欢迎：它们是大公司避免冲击股价的多种交易方式之一。

与其他有价值的事物类似，此类订单同样利弊并存。

但它们究竟包含什么？

暗池订单在执行前不会向公开交易所广播，意味着其存在不会影响市场价格。

但并非所有暗池订单都会停留其中。

我们的使命是照亮暗池交易。

## 暗池如何助我提升交易水平？

学习暗池数据看板的运作方式可提升交易效率。对新手交易者而言，暗池提供更佳的学习途径。

实时学习交易可能伴随风险。最快速的交易者往往占据主导，给尚未精通技艺者留下有限空间。

但在暗池数据看板上，时间永不设限。因为该来的总会来。随着您持续投入学习高效交易之道，会发现信息永不消逝。

关键在于关注市场在您周围的演变。不必畏惧那些已从眼前错误中汲取教训的人。交易之道需时间沉淀，但这条路需步步为营地走。

人各有学法。

多少巧合叠加会打破数学可能性？

最重要的是，持续观察其他交易者在暗池数据看板的互动，洞悉其成败经验。

# What Are Insider Trades And How Does This Info Help With Trading?

Insider trading is when someone with knowledge of important company information uses that knowledge to make money in their own investment accounts.

Insiders are able to do this because they have access to information that the general public does not have access to, like profit and loss statements, quarterly earnings, etc. The general public can only speculate as to how their investments are doing based on rumors, news stories, and other publicly available information.

This means that when an insider trades their company’s stock they have an unfair advantage over regular investors because they can see inside the company and know exactly what’s going on behind the scenes.

At Stonk Tech, we believe it's time to give you the biggest Intel drop in insider trade history.

Get ready to pass the popcorn...

## What Are Insider Trades?

So, what are insider trades? Well, let’s start at ground zero.

The dictionary defines insider trading as the illegal buying or selling of a security by someone who has access to nonpublic information about that security.

Basically, if you have inside information (about anything) that could affect an investment you might make – then don’t trade on it.

![](/blog/3.jpg)

## When is Inside Information Classified as an Insider Trade?

Insider information worth remembering:

If a company employee has confidential material nonpublic information, they have an obligation to keep that info secret.

As soon as they tell another person, whether that be via email or even at a cocktail party, it’s likely an insider trade has taken place.

It’s important to keep in mind that it isn’t just corporate employees who need to be on guard about insider trades. When directors, executive officers, major shareholders, or anyone else receives confidential information, they need to follow insider trading laws as well.

In fact, it’s illegal for them to trade on nonpublic material information even if they didn’t receive it directly from a company employee. (They could have received it indirectly through another individual.)

This is why many investors use calendars that show executives’ buys and sells along with those of corporate insiders so they can better predict when an unexpected event may occur.

![](/blog/3.jpg)

## Is All Inside Information Illegal to Trade On?

Knowledge Made Public: An informed public on Insider trades is what they fear the most.

In most countries, there are no rules which prevent investors from trading on insider information.

The main reason for that is that it would be very hard to get rid of all insider trades.

Thinking logically, it's impossible to track every single person in a company that has some sort of access to inside information (Ie: everyone who might have seen something).

And without any proof that someone traded stocks based on inside information, why should anyone care?

Of course, there's still a huge problem when some people have an unfair advantage over others.

It basically destroys any faith in markets as a free, fair place to trade stocks.

That's why regulators around the world want to make sure that they can punish insider traders if possible.

## Who Are Insiders in the United States?


Insiders in the United States (United States) can be broadly classified into 2 types.

Those 2 categories are:

natural persons and legal entities (both corporations).

Legal entities consisting of officers, directors, significant shareholders, or partners that own 10% or more of a publicly-traded company’s outstanding equity securities fall under the insider category.

These insiders must file public reports disclosing their transactions in a company’s stock within 2 business days.

The Securities Exchange Act of 1934 mandates these disclosures.

These reports provide valuable insights into how different investors view a particular stock. This information can help you make better trading decisions. Insider transactions can also lead to changes in the price of securities.

Wealthy people, such as hedge fund managers, buy large stakes in companies.

They do this if they believe they're undervalued.

Then, they sell them when there is an expected increase in the company’s value.

However, their holdings may not reflect the economic reality of common investors.

Also, company insiders or employees usually have different information than other shareholders.
This gives them an edge over other market participants.

This information can prove to be valuable when predicting a company’s earnings report, pricing trends or stock buyback programs, etc.

So it is prudent to pay attention to these reports if you want to maximize your investment profits over time.

## Can I Get Caught for These Crimes?

Almost all insider trading laws apply to public companies (which just means any corporation that’s traded on a stock exchange).

But there is no legal definition of an insider.

Nor is there a clear-cut distinction between those who possess material non-public information.

Just because you work for a large corporation doesn’t mean you can use its secrets to make money in your personal investment account.

Rather, most insider trading laws center on people who have access to non-public information because they:

Are corporate insiders (i.e., top executives).
Work for an affiliated company (like a subsidiary or parent company).
Control 5% or more of that stock.
Knowingly provide false information about their employer or affiliate. They do so in order to take advantage of market fluctuations caused by new public knowledge.


Want to get news on inside trade activity?

The SEC’s EDGAR system contains a wealth of data on insider trading activity. For example, you can look up all insider transactions by name or ticker symbol in just seconds.

While many financial blogs have compiled similar data, none of them offer such a streamlined search process as EDGAR.

# 什么是内幕交易？这些信息如何助力投资？

内幕交易指掌握重要公司信息者利用该信息在个人投资账户中获利的行为。

内幕人士之所以能做到这一点，是因为他们能获取普通公众无法接触的信息，如损益表、季度收益报告等。公众只能根据传言、新闻报道及其他公开信息推测投资表现。

这意味着当内幕人士交易本公司股票时，他们相对普通投资者具有不公平优势——因其能透视公司内部，确切知晓幕后动态。

在Stonk Tech，我们相信是时候为您揭晓内幕交易史上最重磅情报了。

准备爆米花看戏吧...

## 何谓内幕交易？

那么，什么是内幕交易？让我们从基础说起。

词典将其定义为：掌握证券非公开信息者进行的非法证券买卖行为。

简言之，若您拥有可能影响投资的内部信息（任何类型），切勿据此交易。

![](/blog/3.jpg)

## 何种内部信息构成内幕交易？

值得牢记的内幕信息要点：

若公司员工掌握重大非公开机密信息，即有义务保守秘密。

一旦通过邮件甚至鸡尾酒会向他人透露，即可能构成内幕交易。

需注意：不仅公司员工需警惕内幕交易。董事、高管、大股东或其他任何获取机密信息者，同样需遵守内幕交易法规。

事实上，即使非直接来自公司员工（如通过他人间接获得），依据重大非公开信息交易仍属违法。

正因如此，许多投资者使用高管与公司内部人买卖日历，以更好预测突发事件的时机。

![](/blog/3.jpg)

## 所有内部信息交易皆非法吗？

内幕交易者最恐惧的，正是知情公众的存在。

多数国家未明令禁止依据内幕信息交易。

主因在于彻底杜绝内幕交易难度极大。

逻辑上，追踪公司内所有可能接触内部信息者（即任何可能知情者）并不现实。

若无法证明某人依据内幕信息交易，他人何必在意？

当然，当部分人拥有不公平优势时，问题依然严重。

这从根本上摧毁了市场作为自由公平交易场所的公信力。

故全球监管机构力求严惩内幕交易者。

## 美国如何界定内幕人士？

美国内幕人士可广义分为两类：

自然人与法人实体（含公司）。

持有上市公司流通股10%以上的高管、董事、大股东或合伙人等法人实体均属内幕范畴。

这些内幕人士必须在交易后2个工作日内提交公开报告。

此披露要求源于《1934年证券交易法》。

这些报告为洞察不同投资者对个股看法提供宝贵参考，助您做出更佳交易决策。内幕交易还可能引发证券价格波动。

对冲基金经理等富豪会大举买入他们认为被低估的公司股票，

待公司价值预期上升时抛售。

但其持仓未必反映普通投资者的经济现实。

此外，公司内部人或员工通常掌握不同于其他股东的信息，

使其较其他市场参与者更具优势。

此类信息对预测公司财报、价格趋势或股票回购计划等极具价值。

故长期追求投资利润最大化者，关注这些报告实为明智之举。

## 此类犯罪会被追责吗？

几乎所有内幕交易法规均适用于上市公司（即在证券交易所挂牌的企业）。

但法律未明确定义"内幕人士"，

也未清晰界定重大非公开信息持有者。

并非任职大公司就能利用其机密为个人账户牟利。

实际上，多数内幕交易法规针对以下人群：

公司内部人（如高层管理者） 
关联企业员工（如子公司或母公司） 
控股5%以上者 
为利用新公开信息引发的市场波动，故意散布雇主或关联方虚假信息者 

欲获取内幕交易动态？

美国证监会EDGAR系统蕴藏丰富内幕交易数据。例如您可瞬间按姓名或股票代码检索所有内幕交易。

虽多家财经博客汇编类似数据，但无一能提供EDGAR这般高效的检索流程。

>温馨提示：AI 很聪明，但并非万能。在你将投资组合交给 AI 管理之前，请记住：再强大的系统也不是万无一失。市场充满不确定性，即便是最先进的 AI，也难以准确预测每一次突如其来的波动。

# Why is the Retail Trading Community Becoming So Big?

The retail trading community is becoming increasingly popular, especially in the financial sector. In fact, according to Bloomberg data, this community grew by 20% in the last year alone!

But why?

What makes trading so appealing to so many people?

How does this increase the risk of a potential financial crisis?

Investing can seem daunting at first glance, especially if you’re starting from scratch with no idea where to begin.

If you’re just getting started, or if you’ve been involved in trading for years but still feel like you’re not making the kind of progress you want, retail trading might be your answer.

This post will take you through some of the biggest factors that influence retail trading, and what you can do to trade safely and responsibly.


## The Benefits

The retail trading community has grown considerably over recent years, due to an increasing number of households having a single income or two incomes that are quite similar.

Successful retail traders generally trade in their free time – This means traders can earn extra income from home, which saves them money on transportation costs and enables them to spend more time with their families.

In addition, as most retail traders only trade during evenings and weekends, it does not interfere with work schedules. This means there are many opportunities for people who want to improve their financial situation but cannot leave their job to do so.

Moreover, although trading may seem complicated at first glance, it doesn’t take much time or effort to learn how to begin trading online. In fact, many people begin learning how to make trades while they are still in school!

Because of these reasons and more, trading has become a popular part-time business that can be extremely lucrative for those who have a knack for it!

![](/blog/2.jpg)

At Stonk Tech, we've definitively seen the history of retail trading. And we believe in the social trading community (the free-thinking individual retail traders).

The benefits that are found by trading in the market shouldn't just be available to those who are in control of the trading space. Equal opportunity retail trading for all is what we believe in. And we'll continue to support that idea.

## Worth Remembering: The History of Retail Trading

A few years ago, it would have been almost unheard of for retail traders to set up a trading desk in their basement or room.

However, due to leaps and bounds in computing power, plus fast internet speeds, most households have access to multiple computers at once.

This has led to a massive rise in retail traders.

Social traders who work from home using a laptop and their ability to think logically when they assess the trading space. They often use an online trading platform to execute trades, plus they can do it at any time, in any place, and without being tied to a fixed office environment.

The successful retail traders of yesteryear are, without a doubt, a dying breed.

The tides have turned and the army of social retail traders are the ones who hold the power in the trading space.

Retail traders no longer need a big fat chequebook to open an account with their favourite broker, most will happily trade for less than $200 per month as long as it makes them money!

Individuals deserve to have their cake and eat it too.

The entire system that was in place, doesn't have to be. The people are waking up to what they can achieve with retail trading.

Can you believe how far we've come since retail trading first began?

Who would have thought that our old computers and limited access to telephones, would spawn a community of individuals who can make their own choices with how they trade.

![](/blog/2.jpg)

## The Growth of the Industry

As more traders continue to jump into retail trading, it will continue to grow as a whole.

At Stonk Tech, we think that retail trading has some benefits and drawbacks, but overall it will only continue to grow. This growth won’t be due to a new generation of retail traders being born, but rather because of technology making it easier for everyday people to get involved in day trading.

Day trading isn’t for everyone. However, we believe that people who want to participate in day trading should be able to do so. With that being said, people who want to participate in day trading can’t do so without a solid support system. This includes information, community, and tools.

That’s why Stonk Tech exists. We want to provide people with everything they need to be successful in day trading and build a community around those efforts. As people get involved in retail trading, they’ll realise that there’s a place for them to talk about their experiences and help one another with advice.

They can also find mentors and other resources that can help them be successful. Stonk tech knows that successful retail traders are like high-school athletes. They need to know what they’re doing before they enter a situation where others are judging them.

That’s why we want to make sure everyone gets access to all of our content and materials.

We want you to learn from our mistakes so you don’t have to make them yourself. When you sign up for a free account at Stonk Tech, you gain access to all of our material for free!

## How We Got Here

To understand why retail trading communities are taking off, we have to go back in time to a simpler time...say 1994.

1994 was the year of The Internet.

This technology was still new and it was not widely adopted by most people or businesses.

There were no smartphones, Facebook, Instagram, or YouTube. The first graphical browser, Mosaic, was developed in 1993 and became widely used by 1994. Retail traders back then would use Bulletin Board Systems (BBS) to connect with other traders using a dial-up modem connection.

The rise of BBSs and message boards in 1994 led to discussion forums becoming widely used on websites such as Yahoo! Groups, Google Groups, Facebook, and Reddit today.

Many companies have set up retail trading chat rooms so that new and experienced investors can ask questions about stock trading, Forex trading, or crypto currencies without having to worry about scammers or getting into legal trouble for talking about stocks.

Retail traders on Facebook or Reddit can post their own personal trades. What's more, they can also learn from others in a very supportive community. A great example of a place where retail traders can share their experiences is StockTwits which has millions of users.

They have daily chats with popular financial experts such as Jim Cramer and regular discussions with individual traders on their platform. This enables them to share knowledge easily among themselves through social media sites like Facebook, Twitter, LinkedIn, etc.

As technology gets smarter, so do retail traders.

These days it’s not enough to just trade and watch your profits grow. There are plenty of analysis tools available that can help beginners get a grasp of their portfolios.

Not to mention, a plethora of research tools!

These toolsets allow investors to find information about companies they are thinking of investing in. This allows successful retail traders and social traders to use discernment. Especially before buying their stocks or coins in cryptocurrencies.

Sites like Investopedia have trading forums where people can ask questions and give answers. This helps everyone learn more about trading stocks and make better trades themselves.

## The Next Step – What Is Next For Retail Traders & Their Free Market Exchange Lifestyle?

It’s easy to get wrapped up in technology today. People feel more connected than ever and they are more easily able to communicate with others across vast distances.

It can be a wonderful thing and it is really great that we have become so interconnected. However, there are also challenges that come along with our reliance on technology.

For example, how trading has changed. Before, if you wanted to trade something you had to physically do it. You would make a phone call or meet up somewhere. Nowadays, most of our trading happens on computers.

We trade in marketplaces where we can access all kinds of assets and information with just a few clicks. The Internet has changed everything. There are now platforms that have made it easy for people around the world to engage in retail trading activities.

Not to mention, socializing with others who share similar interests. We have really come a long way when we look at what technology has done for us over time. Now, people are even able to work from anywhere and make trades from anywhere else as well.

Just by using their cell phones and an Internet connection, they're ready for whatever. It can all be very overwhelming for some people; trading online doesn’t always produce optimal results, especially if you don’t know what you are doing.

To help improve your chances of success in trading, there are many places where you can go to educate yourself.

We're talking trading space intel on how things work today.

## Conclusion – Are There Any Questions You May Have About The Future Of Retail Trading?

The retail trading community is growing quickly. At Stonk tech, we know that more and more people are realizing they can manage their own financial futures.

In fact, they can do it better than having a mutual fund manager do it for them. Keep your eye on these markets, too.

That's because they may be some of those most affected by global economic trends. And that’s something you don’t want to miss!

Even if you don’t trade yourself, a deeper understanding of these markets can help you make better decisions about your investments going forward.

content:
# 为什么散户交易社群日益壮大？

散户交易社群正变得越来越受欢迎，尤其是在金融领域。事实上，根据彭博社(Bloomberg)数据，该社群仅去年一年就增长了20%！

但原因何在？

交易为何对如此多人产生吸引力？

这又如何增加了潜在金融危机的风险？

乍看之下，投资似乎令人生畏，尤其当你毫无头绪不知从何开始时。

如果你刚入门，或者参与交易多年却仍感进步不足，散户交易或许正是你的答案。

本文将探讨影响散户交易的关键因素，以及如何安全负责地进行交易。


## 优势所在

近年来散户交易社群显著壮大，这源于越来越多家庭拥有单一或两份相近的收入来源。

成功的散户交易者通常在闲暇时间交易——这意味着交易者能在家赚取额外收入，既节省通勤成本，又能陪伴家人。

此外，多数散户仅在晚间和周末交易，不影响正常工作。这为想改善财务状况却无法离职的人们提供了大量机会。

更重要的是，尽管交易初看复杂，但学习在线交易无需太多时间精力。事实上，许多人早在学生时代就开始学习交易！

基于这些原因，交易已成为广受欢迎的副业，对具备天赋者来说收益尤为可观！

![](/blog/2.jpg)

在Stonk Tech，我们见证过散户交易的发展历程。我们坚信社交交易社群（自由思考的个人散户）的力量。

市场交易的红利不应仅由掌控交易领域者独享。我们信仰人人平等的交易机会，并将持续支持这一理念。

## 值得铭记：散户交易简史

几年前，散户在自家地下室或房间设立交易台几乎闻所未闻。

然而，随着计算能力的飞跃和网络提速，多数家庭已能同时使用多台电脑。

这促使散户交易者激增。

居家办公的社交交易者仅需笔记本电脑，在评估交易空间时展现逻辑思维能力。他们常通过在线交易平台执行操作，不受时间地点限制，也无需固定办公环境。

昔日成功的散户交易者，无疑正逐渐消逝。

潮流逆转，社交散户大军已成为交易领域的主宰者。

散户不再需要巨额支票簿即可在青睐的券商开户，只要能够盈利，多数人乐于接受每月不足200美元的交易额！

个体理应"鱼与熊掌兼得"。

既有体系并非不可改变。人们正逐渐觉醒，意识到通过散户交易能实现的成就。

你能想象自散户交易诞生以来我们取得的进步吗？

谁曾想到，凭借老式电脑和有限的电话通讯，竟能孕育出自主决定交易方式的个体社群。

![](/blog/2.jpg)

## 行业的成长

随着更多交易者加入散户行列，整个行业将持续扩张。

Stonk Tech认为散户交易虽有利弊，但整体必将持续增长。这种增长并非源于新生代交易者涌现，而是技术让普通人更易参与日内交易。

日内交易并非适合所有人。但我们坚信有意参与者应获得机会。当然，成功参与需要完善的支持体系，包括信息、社群和工具。

这正是Stonk Tech存在的意义。我们致力于提供日内交易成功所需的一切资源，并围绕此目标构建社群。当人们参与散户交易后，会发现这里有交流经验、互助献策的空间。

他们还能找到导师和其他辅助成功的资源。Stonk Tech深知成功散户如同高中运动员——在踏入他人评判的赛场前，必须清楚自己的行动。

因此我们确保所有人皆可获取全部内容资源。

望你从我们的教训中学习，避免重蹈覆辙。注册Stonk Tech免费账户，即刻解锁所有资料！

## 发展历程

要理解散户社群为何兴起，需回溯至更简单的年代...譬如1994年。

1994是互联网元年。

当时这项技术仍属新生事物，尚未被大众或企业广泛接纳。

没有智能手机、Facebook、Instagram或YouTube。首个图形浏览器Mosaic于1993年开发，1994年开始普及。那时的散户通过拨号调制解调器连接电子公告板系统(BBS)交流。

1994年BBS和留言板的兴起，催生了如今Yahoo! Groups、Google Groups、Facebook和Reddit等网站的论坛功能。

多家公司设立散户聊天室，让新旧投资者能安心探讨股票、外汇或加密货币交易，无需担心诈骗或法律风险。

Facebook或Reddit上的散户可分享个人交易记录，更能在这个高度互助的社群中向他人学习。StockTwits就是绝佳案例——这个数百万用户的平台让散户交流经验。

他们每日与Jim Cramer等知名金融专家聊天，定期与个体交易者讨论。通过Facebook、Twitter、LinkedIn等社交媒体，知识得以轻松共享。

技术日益智能，散户亦然。

如今仅靠交易和坐等收益增长已不足够。大量分析工具可帮助新手理解投资组合。

更不用说丰富的研究工具！

这些工具让投资者能深入了解意向投资企业。成功的散户和社交交易者从而能在购买股票或加密货币前，尤其能运用判断力。

Investopedia等网站设有交易论坛供问答交流，帮助大众增进交易知识，优化操作。

## 下一步——散户及其自由市场交易生活方式的未来？

当今技术极易让人沉浸其中。人们感觉前所未有的紧密连接，跨越遥远距离的交流变得轻而易举。

这美妙非凡，高度互联确实可喜。然而技术依赖也带来挑战。

例如交易的变革。过去交易需亲力亲为——打电话或线下会面。如今多数交易在电脑完成。

我们在市场中轻点几下即可获取各类资产和信息。互联网改变了一切。现有平台让全球散户轻松参与交易活动。

更可与志趣相投者社交互动。纵观技术带来的变革，我们已取得长足进步。现在人们甚至能随时随地工作交易。

一部手机加网络连接，万事俱备。对某些人可能难以承受；在线交易并非总能产出最佳结果，尤其当你缺乏经验时。

为提高交易成功率，众多渠道可供学习。

我们指的是当前交易领域的运作情报。

## 结语——关于散户交易未来，您可有疑问？

散户交易社群正迅猛成长。Stonk Tech深知越来越多人意识到：自己能够掌控财务未来。

事实上，他们比共同基金经理做得更好。请同时密切关注这些市场。

因为它们可能最受全球经济趋势影响。而这正是你不容错过的！

即使你并非交易者，深入理解这些市场也有助于未来做出更明智的投资决策。


>温馨提示：AI 很聪明，但并非万能。在你将投资组合交给 AI 管理之前，请记住：再强大的系统也不是万无一失。市场充满不确定性，即便是最先进的 AI，也难以准确预测每一次突如其来的波动。

>人工智能应作为辅助决策的工具，而非预测未来的“水晶球”。我们诚邀您阅读我们的研究论文：《构建用于金融指导与经济预测的聊天机器人：基于 GPT 大语言模型与搜索引擎数据的探索》

content:
# Who are the "Retail Trader Army", and How Have They Been in the Spotlight for the Past Two Years?
If you follow the markets at all, then you’ve probably heard of the term retail trader army recently. Since the beginning of 2020, retail trading – as a share of overall market activity – has surged from somewhere between 15% and 18% to more than 30%, according to a report published by Credit Suisse.

Retail traders, also known as individual investors, have become one of the most disruptive forces in the stock market over the past two years, including the GameStop and WallStreetbets mania in early 2020. 
The GameStop bubble has come and gone but one thing may be here to stay: A large group of new, younger, more social-media-savvy retail traders who speak emoji and Reddit. 
But who are retail traders exactly? 

A retail trader can be anyone from an employee who's on the stock options plan at their company to someone who's been watching the financial news and deciding to follow along on the markets while they trade stocks in their free time. 

![](/blog/1.jpg)

These retail traders aren't big firms or banks, but rather people with money to invest and a desire to grow it further by investing in the market directly.


## Why do people trade?


Investing can be an intimidating and frustrating task, but it doesn’t have to be. With so many options available today, like online stock trading and social investing, investing has become easier than ever. 

And with record numbers of individual investors trading stocks in recent years, we now have a market full of novice traders who are looking for tips and advice on how to invest.

![](/blog/2.jpg)

So why do people trade? Because it’s fun. To many, trading stocks is a lot like gambling.

Only with better odds and a bigger pay-off. It’s always exciting to see your profits pile up, and you never know when you might hit it big. 

No matter how much experience you have as an investor, there’s always something new to learn or a new strategy to try out. And every stock is different, so no day will be exactly like another.

Investing doesn’t have to be intimidating, frustrating, or overly complicated. In fact, it can be a lot of fun! And you don’t need to buy a fancy trading app or spend hours researching stocks to get started.

## How did the trend happen? 
These self-made men and women are reinventing trading on their own terms. They’re recreating Wall Street. 

Without a college degree, without a personal mentor, without fancy degrees or four-figure education. They’re making waves that have been mistaken for tsunamis on the beach, thanks to commission-free trading apps like Robinhood and social media like Reddit. 

But how did this happen?

Over ten years ago, you’d be hard-pressed to find an individual investor on Wall Street. These days, you can hardly log into your brokerage account without seeing a plethora of small accounts.

This is largely courtesy of retail trading. The fact is, the silent majority was finally ready to rise to action. You see, this trader army knew exactly what results they wanted. 

These successful retail traders were in the pursuit of:

The trader army unlocked the minds of those who had a dream to be a retail trader on their own terms, but didn't know just where to start. 

The retail trader army taught them how.

![](/blog/3.jpg)


## Trader Army Soldiers Welcome

Now retail traders (people like you and me) are using social media platforms to share trading ideas and strategies with each other; turning into an army that's been disrupting global stock markets over the past year or so. 

The Stonk trader army knows that we must think logically about trading spaces. Our band of social traders asks you to question everything you know about the trading space. Investing your time in uncovering the game theory of the investment space is worth remembering. 

Thanks to a band of retail trader deplorables, we're able to see that freedom from the mainstream investment schemes is happening.

Get ready to enlist as a retail trader now. It's time to hold the line in the Retail Trader Army!

And nothing can stop what is coming.

# 谁是“散户大军”？为何过去两年成为市场焦点？
如果你关注市场，最近可能听说过“散户大军”这个词。根据瑞士信贷（Credit Suisse）发布的一份报告，自2020年初以来，散户交易占整体市场活动的比例已从15%到18%之间飙升至超过30%。

散户交易者（又称个人投资者）已成为过去两年股市最具颠覆性的力量之一，包括2020年初的GameStop（游戏驿站）和WallStreetBets（华尔街赌注）狂热事件。 
GameStop的泡沫虽已消退，但有一件事可能永久改变：一个庞大、年轻、精通社交媒体、用表情包和Reddit语言交流的新生代散户群体已然形成。 
那么究竟谁是散户交易者？ 

散户交易者可以是任何人群——从参与公司股票期权计划的员工，到收看财经新闻后决定在闲暇时间跟风炒股的人。 

![](/blog/1.jpg)

这些散户并非大型机构或银行，而是手握可投资资金、渴望通过直接投资市场实现财富增值的普通人。


## 人们为何参与交易？

投资看似令人却步且充满挫败感，但实则不然。如今在线股票交易、社交投资等多元选择，使投资变得前所未有的便捷。 

随着近年个人投资者交易量创下历史纪录，市场上充斥着寻求投资技巧建议的新手交易者。

![](/blog/2.jpg)

那么人们为何交易？因为有趣。对许多人而言，炒股与赌博极为相似。 

只是胜率更高，回报更丰厚。看着收益累积总是令人兴奋，而你永远不知道何时会大获成功。 

无论投资经验多寡，总有新知识待学习，新策略待尝试。每只股票特性各异，因此每一天都充满新鲜感。 

投资不必令人畏缩、沮丧或过度复杂。事实上，它可以充满乐趣！你无需购买花哨的交易软件，也不必耗费数小时研究个股即可入门。


## 这股风潮如何形成？ 
这群白手起家的交易者正以自己的方式重塑交易规则。他们在重构华尔街。 

无需大学文凭，没有私人导师，不靠华丽学位或万元学费。凭借Robinhood等零佣金交易应用和Reddit类社交媒体，他们掀起的波澜曾被误认作席卷海滩的海啸。 

但这一切如何发生？ 

十年前，在华尔街找到个人投资者难如登天。如今登录经纪账户，满目皆是小型账户。 

这主要归功于散户交易。事实上，沉默的大多数终于准备就绪蓄势待发。你看，这支交易大军对目标结果了然于胸。 

成功散户交易者追求的是： 

这支大军唤醒了那些渴望自主交易却不知从何起步的追梦者。 

散户交易大军指引了他们方向。 

![](/blog/3.jpg)


## 欢迎加入交易者军团 

如今散户交易者（你我这样的普通人）正通过社交媒体平台互相分享交易理念与策略，逐渐形成一支过去一年撼动全球股市的"军团"。 

"Stonk"交易军团深知必须理性思考交易领域。我们的社交交易团队请你质疑对交易领域的一切认知。值得铭记的是：投入时间揭示投资领域的博弈论具有非凡价值。 

多亏这支"被轻视的"散户军团，我们得以见证脱离主流投资体系的自由正在实现。 

立即准备入伍成为散户交易者吧！是时候在散户大军中守住阵线了！ 

即将到来的趋势无可阻挡。

>温馨提示：AI 很聪明，但并非万能。在你将投资组合交给 AI 管理之前，请记住：再强大的系统也不是万无一失。市场充满不确定性，即便是最先进的 AI，也难以准确预测每一次突如其来的波动。
